title: Write-Only Accumulators (Dead Collections)
pattern: Declaring, instantiating, and pushing items into a collection (Vector, HashMap, etc.) that is never read, returned, or queried.
why_bad: Wastes memory allocations and cpu cycles performing dead insertions on a collection that has zero downstream effects.
detection: Collection variables that are mutated (e.g., via `push`, `insert`) but are never read, printed, or returned.
fix: Delete the collection and all operations mutating it.
source: Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code* (2008), Chapter 17 ("Smells and Heuristics - G9: Dead Code"), p. 168.
